title: refactor(console-ai): type metadataApps, drop per-access _packageId casts
body:
Batch A1 from the optimization tracking issue #2487 (review #2478).

## Change
The AI chat switcher + bound-package derivations cast `(app as { _packageId?: string })` at every access (4 sites). This narrows `useMetadata().apps` **once** to a local `MetadataAppItem` shape at the hook boundary; call sites now read `.name` / `.label` / `._packageId` without casts.

**Type-only, no runtime change.** `label` is typed as `Parameters<typeof resolveI18nLabel>[0]` so it stays compatible.

## Tests
Helper suites green (`deriveBoundPackageId`, `editModeEmptyState` — 16); `tsc --noEmit` clean.
